_comment: Sound effects for the narration recordings (npm run sfx → content/sfx/preview/). 'sounds': one entry per sound, generated once with ElevenLabs Sound Effects from 'prompt' ('seconds' 0.5–30, 'loop' for beds), or 'file' for your own recording. 'files': cues per recording. A cue is anchored to a phrase of the text ('at', or 'start'); 'edge' start|end picks the start or end of that phrase, 'offset' shifts it in seconds, 'gain' is the level in dB relative to the voice: every sound is first matched to the voice's average level, so 0 = as loud as the voice and -10 = clearly in the background, whatever the generated file's own loudness. 'to' (a phrase or 'end') turns the cue into a looped bed. 'repeat' plays it several times: 'every' seconds apart, 'anchor' last = the last one lands on the phrase, 'gainFrom' = level of the first one. 'trim' cuts a sound to that many seconds.

knock.prompt: Three firm knocks on a heavy wooden hotel room door in a quiet corridor at night, close, dry, no music, no voices

door-open.prompt: An old heavy wooden hotel room door opening slowly with a soft creak, interior, close, no music, no voices

door-close.prompt: A heavy wooden hotel room door closing gently, ending with a soft latch click, interior, close, no music

growl.prompt: A large dog growling low and quiet from deep in its chest, steady and menacing, close microphone, no barking, no music

snow-steps.prompt: Two people walking slowly side by side over fresh snow at night in a quiet, empty old-town street, soft crunching footsteps, no voices, no traffic, no music

pummerin.prompt: A single toll of an enormous, very deep cathedral bell heard from a few streets away across a quiet snowy city at night, long resonant decay, no other bells, no music

clock-strike.prompt: A single strike of a large old tower clock bell, heard from inside the building through walls, deep and slightly muffled, resonant decay, no ticking, no music

rumble.prompt: A short deep rumble and shudder running through an old building as a heavy hidden mechanism releases, wood and stone, no music

shelf-opens.prompt: A heavy wooden bookshelf swinging open like a hidden door, slow deep wooden creak ending in a soft thud, interior, no music
